spec.name: Orange Kitchen Margherita Pizza
spec.description: A whole, round stepped pizza with a raised golden crust, rich tomato sauce and irregular pools of melted ivory cheese. Toasted edges and connected cheese patches give the three-ingredient recipe strong inventory readability. Ground bottom is y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Margherita Pizza. Whole round stepped pizza with crust rim, melted cheese patches and distinctive toppings. Preserve a genuinely round-ish voxel silhouette, not square flat sheets. Actual recipe ingredients: pizza base, tomato sauce, cheese. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
